thread:
ralph: Noticed during rwd-v4.1 quant4 ensemble smoke that the top-1 generation flips between ensemble members on long-doc QAs. Canary at 6%. Need a rollout gate idea that handles inter-model disagreement rather than pure mean delta.
sana: saw it on the dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v4.1/quant4_ensemble  disagreement concentrated on multi-hop QAs and rerank backfills.
felix: hypothesis: quant increases intra-model variance so ensemble voting becomes unstable; simple averaging hides flip-rate. We should gate on ensemble consensus (fraction of members agreeing on top answer) and also on pairwise agreement rate.
ralph: concrete proposal:
- new gate metric: consensus_rate = fraction_of_models_with_topk_overlap(top1) across ensemble
- require consensus_rate >= 0.75 AND mean_mrr_delta <= 0.03 for promote
- per-request fallback: if consensus_rate < 0.5 then route that request to single high-fidelity model (rwd-v4.1-fp32)
- add hysteresis: once a session triggers fallback keep it pinned for 20m

sana: add shadowing ramp: for requests where consensus_rate between 0.5-0.75, shadow to fp32 100% for 2h and log tie-break traces. That will give fast signal without blocking traffic.
felix: config snippet (rollout policy DSL):
```
rule: ensemble_consensus_gate
match: model_family == "rwd-v4.1"
metrics:
  consensus_rate: ">=0.75"
  mean_mrr_delta: "<=0.03"
per_request:
  fallback_threshold: "consensus_rate < 0.5"
  fallback_action: route_to: rwd-v4.1-fp32
  shadow_on_margin_low: "0.5 <= consensus_rate < 0.75"
  shadow_duration_mins: 120
hysteresis_minutes: 20
```

ci-bot: rollout-config PR check queued. Please include unit test for consensus_rate calc.
ralph: telemetry guards: if fallback_routed_pct > 2% OR pinned_session_latency_increase > 120ms for 10m then auto-pause canary and page #eng-oncall. Also add auto-shrink thermostat: if mean_mrr_delta > 0.04 for 15m shrink canary by 50%.
sana: runbook note: track "flip_rate" metric (percent of requests where top1 differs across models) and add a small smoothing window to avoid flapping: require flip_rate > 5% for two consecutive 5m windows before action.
felix: we'll also compute pairwise agreement matrix to see if one ensemble member is the oddball; if so, consider staged removal or replace with quantized variant with different seed.
ralph: action plan:
- reduce canary 6% -> 2%
- enable ensemble_consensus_gate and shadow margin band
- increase shadow sampling for multi-hop QA cohort to 100% for 24h
- owner: felix 12h watch, sana gate PR, ralph deploy coordinate

route-bot: queued change: adjust-canary rwd-v4.1 quant4_ensemble -> {canary:2%, ensemble_consensus_gate:active, shadow_margin:100% for cohort="multi-hop-qa" 24h}
ci-bot: PR link opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/1210. CI checks pending.
ops-bot: created monitor MON_ENSEMBLE_1845671234 for consensus_rate, flip_rate, fallback_routed_pct, pinned_session_latency. Pager thresholds set.
felix: ran a quick staged replay with gate and shadowing: consensus_rate uplifted effective baseline because we caught oddball requests, flip_rate down ~60% in replay. attaching traces.
sana: scheduling a 3h interim check; if flip_rate stays <3% and fallback_routed_pct <1% we can step canary up slowly. If thermostat shrinks twice -> full pause and rollback to v4.0-fp32.
ralph: thanks all. keep messaging in this thread; post short updates every 3h. if ops-bot pages, we rollback immediately. :thumbsup:
